sets.name: DNC ilvl 665 - DT Relic
sets.description: This set is an ilvl 665 synced set (primarily for Mount Rokkon and Aloalo Island Criterion dungeons). The weapon is the ilvl 795 DT Relic with "CRIT + DET > DH". The left side pieces are current ilvl 790 bis armor in patch 7.4. The right side pieces are ilvl 660 accessories from either p9s or bought with poetics. Watch the melds for tiering purposes.

sets.name: DNC ilvl 665 - EW Relic
sets.description:
This set is an ilvl 665 synced set (primarily for Mount Rokkon and Aloalo Island Criterion dungeons). The weapon is the Manderville ilvl 665 Relic with "CRIT + DET > DH". The left side pieces are current ilvl 790 bis armor in patch 7.4. The right side pieces are ilvl 660 accessories from either p9s or bought with poetics. Watch the melds for tiering purposes.

This set is identical to the one posted in 7.4

description: With patch 7.55 the 795 DT Relic is now available which is better than the EW Relic for this synced content. Both sets are listed here depending on what gear you have access to. The DT Relic set does about 28 more dps (or 0.26% more damage).
